hub.tagline: Pour colors between tubes until every color lands in one tube of its own.

all.title: Pour onto a matching color, or an empty tube
all.desc: Tap a tube to pick it up, then tap another to pour. A pour only works if the other tube is empty or its top color matches yours.

all.title: The whole top group moves together
all.desc: You don't choose how much pours -- every consecutive unit of that color on top moves at once, as much as fits.

all.title: Get every color into one tube each to win
all.desc: A tube counts once it is completely empty or completely full of a single color. Sort every color that way and the board is solved. Stuck? Hint highlights the next move.

game.hintFailToast: No move from here reaches a win -- try resetting.
